paite: Huan Zophar Naaman miin a dawng a, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

paite: Huaijiakin ka ngaihtuahnaten kei dawnna a honpiaa, ka sunga om ka kinna thu jiak mahmahin.
english: “Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

paite: Kei honzahlaksak salhna ka zataa, huan ka theihsiamna khain a hondawng hi.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

paite: Lei tunga mihing koiha a om nungsiah, hun lui thu hiai na theikei maw;
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

paite: Gilou vualzohna a toma, huan pathianlimsakloute nuamsakna mitphiat kal sunglel ahi chih?
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

paite: A hoihkimna vante phain tuangtou mahleh, a luin meipite pha mahleh;
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

paite: Himahleh amah ek bangin khantawnin a mangthang dinga: Koia om ahia? amah muten a chi ding uh.
english: yet he shall perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him shall say, ‘Where is he?’

paite: Mang bangin a lengmang dinga, huan muhin a omkei ding hi: ahi, jan mengmuh banga hawlmangin a om ding hi.
english: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found. Yes, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.

paite: Amah mu mitin amah a muta kei ding hi; a munin leng amah a muta kei ding hi.
english: The eye which saw him shall see him no more, neither shall his place any more see him.

paite: A taten gentheite deihsakna a zong ding ua, huan a khutten a hauhsakna ape nawn ding hi.
english: His children shall seek the favor of the poor. His hands shall give back his wealth.

paite: A guhte a tuailainain a dima, himahleh leivui ah amah toh a lum ding hi.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth shall lie down with him in the dust.

paite: Gitlouhna a kam ah khum mahleh, a lei ah sel mahleh;
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

paite: Sitin, paisak keiin, a kam sungah kem gige zo mahleh;
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;

paite: Himahleh a gila a an a kitoka, a sunga khuai gu ahi hi.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

paite: Hauhsaknate a nawmvalha, huan a lokhe nawn ding hi: Pathianin a gilpi akipanin apaikhe ding hi.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

paite: Khuai gu a tep dia: gul leiin amah a that ding.
english: He shall suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue shall kill him.

paite: Luipite, khuaiju leh nawituidat lui luangte a en kei ding hi.
english: He shall not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

paite: Sepgim gah a pe nawn dia huan a nawmvalh suk kei ding hi; a muhsa ah kipahna a neikei ding.
english: That for which he labored he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down. According to the substance that he has gotten, he shall not rejoice.

paite: Aman lah gentheite a nuaisiaha, a mangngilh hi; a lam louhpi in hiamgamtakin alata.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

paite: A deihgawlnain tawp aneihlouhjiakin, a kipahpih thil himhim a khol kei ding.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he shall not save anything of that in which he delights.

paite: A nekgaihlouh bangmah omlai a om kei hi; huaijiakin a hauhnain a daih sawt kei ding.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

paite: A nian san lain haksa sakna a nei dia: gimthuak mi chiteng khut a tungah a hongtung ding.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress shall overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery shall come on him.

paite: A gilpi hihdim dinga a kisaklaiin, Pathianin a tungah a thangpaihna kihtakhuaina a khe dinga, a nek laiin a tungah a zusak ding hi.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

paite: Sik galvan akipan a tai dia, huan dal thalin amah a kap pailet ding.
english: He shall flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow shall strike him through.

paite: A dok khiaa, huan a pumpi akipanin a hongpai khia: ahi a sinkha apat a mukzum te velvel hongpai khiaa launate a tungah a hongtung hi.
english: He draws it forth, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

paite: A gou dingin mialna tengteng kholkhawmin a om: mi mutlouh meiin amah a negai ding; a puanina nutsiata om a negai ding hi.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire shall devour him. It shall consume that which is left in his tent.

paite: Vanten a thulimlouhna a taklang ding ua, huan lei amah dou dingin a thou ding.
english: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity. The earth shall rise up against him.

paite: A ina punna a paimang dinga, a vante a heh niin a luang mang ding hi.Hiai bel Pathian akipana mi gilou tantuan ahi, a gouluah dia Pathianin a sehsak.
english: The increase of his house shall depart. They shall rush away in the day of his wrath.

paite: Hiai bel Pathian akipana mi gilou tantuan ahi, a gouluah dia Pathianin a sehsak.
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
